audio.natural_sound: unclear (the transcript only has the mother's voiceover)

captions_on_screen: burned-in subtitles of the speech, white text with dark outline, one or two lines in the middle of the frame; key words highlighted in purple (for example 'מדינות', 'חיבוק', 'הופה', 'תודה'); a permanent pink 'Mebook.ai' tag at the bottom; emoji stickers (globes, party poppers, bells, praying hands)
editing_rhythm: 12 cuts from ffmpeg, about 13 shots, average 3.9 s, mostly one continuous handheld take with a few jump cuts; slow, no speed ramps seen
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s: toddler with the back cover and subtitle 'ותודה Mebook על המסע הקסום', then a black frame at 50.5 s. No spoken or written call to action; the caption has none. The only commerce cue is the code printed on the book page
price_or_code: Code 'mebook25545' printed on the thank-you page, readable at about 33-41 s; wording about a 10% discount partly unreadable
convincing: Interpretation: the real toddler's reaction and the moment she points at her own illustrated self do the selling without any claim; the book is shown as a physical object she handles.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: the video is almost wholly a thank-you with no price, no how-to-order and no CTA; disclosure of the partnership is only a watermark; the transcript's repetition at the end suggests the final 20 s are a quiet outro; sticker emojis are slightly busy.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: film the child's first encounter with her own book from above on a bed in natural light, open on the cover and a reaction, point out the moment of self-recognition and show the printed interior pages; add a clear CTA, which this Reel lacks.
solo_without_child: no, the whole Reel rests on a toddler reacting to her own book; a partial version could show only the book and flipping pages
not_verified: Whether the book was a gift or paid for (the machine transcript says 'received', not disclosed on screen); what the discount page text exactly says; the 'סרדם' word in the transcript looks garbled; the long repetition in the last transcript segment is probably a Whisper loop; the speaker's identity (the voice is not matched to anyone on camera)
